book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MARCOS

content: Yal Comam Jesús ta chiuchcꞌalaxayo yatut Comam Dios
Yet lan̈an yelti Comam Jesús yul yatut Comam Dios, yalni huneꞌ naj iscuywom Comam: —Mamin, ¡ilcꞌanab huntekꞌan chꞌen chꞌen yeb huntekꞌan nimeta n̈a tiꞌ lah! ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Huntekꞌan nimeta n̈a tiꞌ chiuchcꞌalaxtoj, matxa hunu chꞌen chꞌen latzꞌbil tiꞌ chican yiban̈ yet chꞌenal, ẍi Comam.
Huntekꞌan yechel chu yet chihul islahobal tzꞌayic

Lahwi tuꞌ xin, isto Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj iscuywom yin̈ istzalanil won̈an Olivo ayco yetcꞌulal satacꞌtiꞌ yatut Comam Dios; yay tzꞌon̈no Comam bey tuꞌ. Iskꞌamben naj Pedro, naj Juan yeb naj Andrés tet Comam yet ischuquilxan̈e:
—Mamin, hal jetan̈ bakꞌin chihul huntekꞌan chawal tiꞌ, ¿tzettaxca yechel chiyu yet chijni isba? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Caw cheyil heba, machojab mac chexakꞌni subchahoj.
Yuto caw txꞌiꞌal ebnaj chuli cat isbalnico ebnaj inbihan yin̈, cat yalni ebnaj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Hanintiꞌan Cristo hinan,” ẍi ebnaj. Caw xin txꞌiꞌal mac chisubcha yu ebnaj.
Hayet cheyabeni ta ay howal hecawilal maca nahata, mach chexxiwi yuto yilal yuni huntekꞌan tiꞌ, cat iswejchacan̈ anma, yajaꞌ maẍto istan̈balo huneꞌ yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.

Chakꞌlecan̈ howal ej txꞌotxꞌ nimeta con̈ob yeb huntekꞌanxa txꞌotxꞌ nimeta con̈ob, cat yanipaxico howal huneꞌ con̈ob yin̈ huneꞌxa con̈ob. Caw xin txꞌiꞌal bay chiecꞌ chixcab yeb wahil, yajaꞌ huntekꞌan tuꞌ yichebaniln̈e isyaꞌtajil.

Caw cheyil heba yuto chexálaxico sata ebnaj yahaw con̈ob, cat hemakꞌlax yulaj capilla. Chexalaxpaxico sata ebnaj gobernador yeb sata ebnaj rey, yu ayexxaco yul inkꞌaban. Hac tuꞌ xin chu quinheyalnilojan tet ebnaj.
Yet maẍto chitan̈ilo yul yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, yilal ispujbalaxicꞌo Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile yulajla txꞌotxꞌ nimeta con̈ob.

Hayet chexalaxico sata ebnaj yahaw con̈ob tuꞌ, mach cheyaco yin̈ hecꞌul yin̈ tzet cheyala; wal xin haꞌ tzet chihallax teyet yu Comam Dios haꞌ cheyala, yuto maẍtajex chextzoteli, to haꞌ Comam Espíritu Santo.
Haꞌ yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, ay ebnaj chaco yuẍta yul iskꞌab camical, ay mame miꞌe chaco yuninal yul iskꞌab camical, aypaxo ebnaj uninale chiyaco howal yin̈ ismam yeb ismiꞌ cat yakꞌni camoj.
Caw sunil anma chioc ishowal teyin̈ yuto ayexico yul inkꞌaban, yajaꞌ mac chitecha yu masanto yet islahobal, chicolchahi.

Tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yu huneꞌ ischejab Comam Dios chiyij Daniel, tato yilal yul naj chietanto yatut Comam Dios yu istxꞌojal chiswatxꞌe. Haꞌ mac chiilni huneꞌ tiꞌ txumchahojabilo yu. Yin̈ huneꞌ tzꞌayic tuꞌ, mac hex ayex bey Judea tiꞌ, chexelcan̈ cat heto iswiꞌla witz.
Mac ayahto yiban̈ yatut xin matxahojab chiayti yikꞌalti hunu tzet ye tuꞌ.
Wal mac ayto xol ismunil, matxahojab chimeltzo yikꞌalti xil iskꞌap yul yatut.
¡Caw cꞌanchꞌan ebix ix ayxa tzet yehi, yeb ebix chito txutxwi niẍte yunin yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ!
Kꞌanwe tet Comam Dios haxinwal maẍtaj yin̈ n̈abil chihul huneꞌ tuꞌ.

Yuto caw chiecꞌyaꞌ yanma anma yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ. Huntekꞌan isyaꞌtajil tuꞌ maẍto hunelo chuhi yichitax iswatxꞌen Comam Dios huneꞌ yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, matxa xin bakꞌinal chuhi yet chilahwi yunicanoj.
Ta mach chiscꞌotzba Comam Dios Jahawil yoj huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, machi hunu mac chicolchahi, wal xin chiscꞌotzba Comam yuto xahan ay yuninal Comam yu, huntekꞌan sicꞌbilxaloj.
Yuxin ta ay mac chihalni teyet: “Haꞌ bey tiꞌ ay naj Cristo lah,” maca ta “Haꞌ bey tuꞌ ay naj lah,” ta ẍi, mach cheyayto yul heyanma.

Yuto caw txꞌiꞌal ebnaj lekꞌtiꞌwom chisbalico isba Cristohal. Aypaxo ebnaj chisbalico isba ischejabo Comam Dios cat isyeni ebnaj cꞌaybalcꞌule yeb yechel yip naj matzwalil yun̈e issubcha anma yu ebnaj. Etza xin chisubchapaxo ebnaj sicꞌbilxa yu Comam Dios yu ebnaj.
¡Caw cheyil heba xin! Yalan̈to chiwalnicanojan huntekꞌan tiꞌ teyet, ẍi Comam.
Yin̈ tzet chu yul Comam Jesucristo yin̈ iscayelal
Hayet chilahwi yecꞌcano huntekꞌan isyaꞌtajil tuꞌ, chikꞌejholilo yoj tzꞌayic, matxa chimujlipaxo ixahaw,
cat istitcꞌay ej txꞌumel ay satcan̈, cat xin isbilipaxo sunil tzet ay yip ay yul satcan̈.
Lahwi tuꞌ cat yillax wulan xol moyan, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios. Chinhulan yeb sunil iskꞌakꞌal wipan,
cat inchejni wángelan iscutxbanoco sunil mac sicꞌbilxalo wuhan yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, sunil baytajtuꞌwal ay anma bay chiecꞌ ebnaj.
Txumwecꞌanab yin̈ teꞌ higuera: Yet chielilo ischon iskꞌab teꞌ cat yul xaj teꞌ, cheyohtan̈eloj ta toxa chioc haꞌ n̈ab.
Hac tuꞌ ye huntekꞌan chiwaltiꞌan. Hayet cheyilni yijni isba huntekꞌan tuꞌ, yilal heyohtan̈eni tato cawilxa yeti bay chinhulan.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet; sunil huntekꞌan tiꞌ chiyu yalan̈to maẍto chicam huntekꞌan anma tiꞌ.
Haꞌ satcan̈ yeb txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ tiꞌ chitan̈iloj, wal Intzotiꞌan xin mach chiecꞌto yet yijni isba tzet chala.

Yajaꞌ wal yin̈ tzet tzꞌayical yeb tzet orahil chinhulan machi hunu mac ohtan̈e nitam ebnaj ángel ay yul satcan̈. Mach wohtapaxojan, Hanin Iscꞌahol Comam Dios intiꞌan; wal xin han̈cꞌan̈e Inmaman ohtan̈e.
Yuxin caw nann̈e heyu, majwan̈wej yuto mach heyohtajo tzet orahil chinhulan.

Lahan hacaꞌ yet chito hunu naj yahaw n̈a yin̈ hunu isbel caw nahat. Yalan̈to maẍto chito naj chalnicano naj tzettaj munilal chu hunun ischejab, cat yalnicano naj tet naj tan̈em pulta tato caw chil naj istiꞌ pulta tuꞌ.

Ebnaj chejab tuꞌ, mach yohtajo ebnaj bakꞌin chimeltzo naj yahaw n̈a, mach yohtajo ebnaj tato hayet yahbal akꞌbal chul naj, maca yin̈ chuman akꞌbal, maca yet chiokꞌ noꞌ chiyo, maca yet sahab sacꞌayal. Haquexpax tuꞌ mach heyohtajo bakꞌin chinhulan, yuxin majwahan̈wej,
tajca tona nahul ayex cat wul lemnahan.
Huntekꞌan tiꞌ, maẍn̈etaj teyet chiwalan, to chiwalpaxojan tet sunil anma. ¡Caw majwahan̈wej! ẍi Comam.
